t1.RELEASE_NO: key: edition tie-break in cbs.grid (history_releases 1); the edition number on the page comes from the releases input
t1.RELEASE_DATE: key: newest edition — selects its rows
t1.ROW: key: row order; labels are found by text, not by row number
t1.C03: chart-recent, kpi:ytd — roman month / I-X year-to-date label
t1.C04: skip: empty in every row (print-layout spacer column)
t1.C05: skip: by air, monthly % change of the trend (the page uses the total)
t1.C06: skip: by air, trend (chart-heat shows t5's longer by-air series)
t1.C08: chart-years, table:years — by air, original (yearly rows); the 'Thereof: By air' header locates the block
t1.C09: insight:trend — total, monthly % change of the trend
t1.C12: chart-years, chart-recent, kpi:month, kpi:month_chg, kpi:ytd, kpi:ytd_chg, kpi:peak, insight:month, insight:ytd, insight:peak, insight:shock — total departures, original
t1.C13: skip: empty in every row (print-layout spacer column)
t1.C14: skip: roman month label repeated on the Hebrew side
t1.C16: skip: year label repeated on the Hebrew side
t2.RELEASE_NO: key: edition tie-break in cbs.grid (history_releases 1); the edition number on the page comes from the releases input
t2.RELEASE_DATE: key: newest edition — selects its rows
t2.ROW: key: row order; labels are found by text, not by row number
t2.C12: chart-ages, chart-age-ytd, chart-male, insight:ages — age 0-19, departures (also the Hebrew header label column)
t2.C14: skip: year label repeated on the Hebrew side
t3.RELEASE_NO: key: edition tie-break in cbs.grid (history_releases 1); the edition number on the page comes from the releases input
t3.RELEASE_DATE: key: newest edition — selects its rows
t3.ROW: key: row order; labels are found by text, not by row number
t3.C03: skip: CBS's rounded % of departures by Israelis living abroad (recomputed from C04/C05 for one decimal)
t3.C04: chart-abroad, table:abroad_years, insight:abroad — departures of Israelis living abroad (thousands)
t3.C07: skip: year label repeated (also the table title)
t4.RELEASE_NO: key: edition tie-break in cbs.grid (history_releases 1); the edition number on the page comes from the releases input
t4.RELEASE_DATE: key: newest edition — selects its rows
t4.ROW: key: row order; labels are found by text, not by row number
t4.C01: skip: English route names (the page uses the Hebrew ones in C11); its English block labels are read from the label row
t4.C02: skip: % change vs two years earlier (computed from the values instead)
t4.C03: skip: % change vs a year earlier (computed from the values instead)
t4.C04: chart-crossings, table:routes — year to date, two years earlier
t4.C05: chart-crossings, table:routes, insight:land — year to date, a year earlier
t4.C06: chart-crossings, chart-modes, table:routes, insight:land — year to date, this year
t4.C07: skip: the month, two years earlier (the monthly figures come from t1)
t4.C08: skip: the month, a year earlier (the monthly figures come from t1)
t4.C09: skip: the month, this year (the monthly figures come from t1)
t4.C10: skip: a stray print cell (a '2017*' header and one 0); not part of either block
t4.C11: chart-crossings, chart-modes — Hebrew route / crossing name
t5.RELEASE_NO: key: edition tie-break in cbs.grid (history_releases 1); the edition number on the page comes from the releases input
t5.RELEASE_DATE: key: newest edition — selects its rows
t5.ROW: key: row order; labels are found by text, not by row number
t5.C02: chart-heat — roman month marker (checked against the row count)
t5.C03: chart-heat, table:heat — departures by air, original
t5.C04: skip: seasonally adjusted (t1 carries the monthly SA series)
t5.C08: skip: trend by air (read, not shown; t1's trend is the page's trend line)
t5.C09: skip: empty in every row (chart sheet layout)
t5.C10: skip: chart-sheet titles and notes only
releases.TITLE: text: the latest-edition card
releases.HEADLINE: text: the latest-edition card (CBS's one-line summary)
releases.PAGE_URL: text: link to the release on cbs.gov.il
releases.REPORT_PDF_URL: text: link to the written report (PDF)
